title: Criteria for Reduction in Silver Support Payout Quantum
what_it_is: Criteria for Reduction in Silver Support Payout Quantum

sections.label: Silver Support payouts and enhancements
sections.summary: Government will disburse about $600 million in Silver Support payouts to almost 250,000 seniors in 2021, with a new payout tier and automatic CPF notification.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In total, the Government will disburse about $600 million in Silver Support payouts to almost 250,000 seniors in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This is nearly double the $330 million paid out to 150,000 seniors in 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: As part of scheme enhancements that were implemented this year, we introduced a new payout tier for seniors with higher household monthly income per person.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Prior to 2021, seniors who experience an improvement in circumstances may no longer receive Silver Support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: With the new payout tier, such seniors could continue to receive Silver Support payouts of a reduced quantum.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: All seniors who are eligible for Silver Support in any given year are automatically notified of their payout amounts by the Central Provident Fund (CPF) Board in December of the preceding year.

sections.label: CPF hotline and appeals
sections.summary: Seniors may call the CPF Board hotline to check eligibility and payout changes, appeals are considered case-by-case, and informing recipients of specific reasons is under review.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: They may also call the CPF Board hotline to check their eligibility status and reasons for their changes in payouts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We will consider appeals on a case-by-case basis.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We are also reviewing the feasibility of informing recipients of the specific reasons for the changes in their payout quantums.
